territorial_scope.description: Applies within the City of Dublin, California, to one named transit authority and any private entity participating with it.

evidence.quote: The testing shall be conducted only within the City of Dublin

summary.short: Authorizes the Livermore Amador Valley Transit Authority, with or without a private entity, to test shared autonomous vehicles without a driver seat, steering wheel or pedals within the City of Dublin. Testing requires insurance of $5,000,000, a Department of Motor Vehicles submission, and speeds under 35 mph. Inoperative May 1, 2018; repealed January 1, 2019.
summary.long: Adds Vehicle Code Section 38756, which authorizes the Livermore Amador Valley Transit Authority to conduct a shared autonomous vehicle (SAV) demonstration project for vehicles without a driver seat, steering wheel, brake pedal or accelerator. Testing is limited to the City of Dublin and the vehicles must operate at speeds of less than 35 miles per hour. Before testing on public roads, the authority or a private entity must obtain insurance, surety bond or proof of self-insurance of $5,000,000 and provide evidence to the Department of Motor Vehicles, and must submit a detailed testing program. The program must cover controlled-condition testing, local authority approval of the area and conditions, operation only in the authorized area, compliance with federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards or an NHTSA exemption, a communication link to a remote operator, and a law enforcement interaction plan. The operator must disclose to participants what personal information the vehicle collects. The department may require data collection, including accident reports within 10 days and an annual report on unplanned technology disengagements. The demonstration project may not be conducted if the department adopts regulations under Section 38750 by December 31, 2017. The section becomes inoperative on May 1, 2018 and is repealed as of January 1, 2019.
